description: Searches Chop It's catalogue of 1,000+ tested recipes and returns recipe cards (title, photo, time, tags, protein) with links into the app. Suits dinner ideas, a named dish, protein, cuisine or dietary need, or ideas built around ingredients the user mentions. Structured filters are hard constraints: 'quick chicken dinners' maps to filters.protein ['chicken'] and filters.maxTimeMins 30. The query text is also parsed for protein, time, dietary and dinner intent as a fallback, and dinner-intent searches leave out sides, dips and starters. limit is the page size (at most 20) and total is every match; pass nextOffset as offset while hasMore is true to read the rest. A query that names nothing in the catalogue returns no recipes and a note. Search cards never include method steps. Without an account, results come from the fixed 100-recipe guest preview; a linked account searches the complete catalogue. Read-only and search results do not change a menu draft.

minFibreG.description: Minimum credible estimated fibre grams per serving; unknown nutrition is not a match.

limit.description: Page size. total in the result is the whole match count.

offset.description: Start at 0, then pass nextOffset from the previous page while hasMore is true.

query.description: What to search the Chop It catalogue for, e.g. 'chicken traybake'.

name: search_recipes
title: Search Chop It recipes
